content.short: Swap, earn, stack yields, lend, borrow, leverage all on one decentralized, community driven platform.
content.description:
Cardance is an innovative platform of the Cardano community that allows democratization of access to tokens in a decentralized way.

With this system, you can provide liquidity for people to exchange native tokens, in return the players earn a fee paid on each swap. In addition, through an order book it is possible to execute transactions even though partially according to the new exchange process, decreasing the payment of fees and giving swappers an progressively better average price.

This whitepaper aims to show an initial product modeled following the main market standards proof-of-stake mechanism and with several innovative adaptations for the Cardano blockchain
